## Mapping: mockup `pageTitles` -> PBIX page displayName

`mockups/welding-dashboard 1.html` declares 44 page titles; the PBIX has 145 pages. 
The mockup titles are cleaned-up rewrites, not copies, so matching is structural: each title and 
each page displayName is reduced to `(category, subcontractors, RT percentages, slug-catcher flag)` 
where category is one of PWHT / NDE / REJ / WELDING / OTHER. A title whose tuple hits exactly one 
page is a **unique structural match** (this covers every NDE, PWHT and rejection page). The first 
11 titles are generic "<SUBCO> WELDING STATUS" strings that match several pages, so they are 
**order-inferred**: the mockup preserves report page order, so they are assigned to the 
order-preserving subsequence of welding-status pages that ends before the first anchor and whose 
named subcontractor matches. 30 such subsequences exist; the 2 most compact (page-index span 11) 
are kept and every slot where they disagree is listed with all its options.

Independent corroboration for the inferred block: mockup title 9 
"GAC WELDING STATUS (Slug Catcher Area)" lands on page 29 `Rep. Welding- GAC- SLG` — the only 
GAC slug-catcher page in the report — and title 2 "Project Welding & NDE Status" lands on page 22 
`REP. Project Welding & NDE Status +INCO+Acciona`, a near-verbatim string match. Neither was used 
to build the assignment.

29 of 44 mockup titles resolve to exactly one PBIX page structurally; 11 are order-inferred; 
4 remain ambiguous; 0 have no candidate.

The 4 "ambiguous" rows are titles 41-44 ("Weld Rejection Detail - <SUBCO>"). Their structural 
tuple also matches the "<SUBCO> Welders Performance. Cumulative Rejection Rate" pages (88-91), 
because both mention rejection. Pages 65-68 ("... Weld Rej. Detail as per WPS") are the ones the 
mockup reproduces — per-WPS rejection detail, not per-welder cumulative rate — and they also 
continue the contiguous block. Both candidates are listed rather than silently dropped.

The mockup therefore covers a **contiguous slice of the report**: the "REP./Rep." per-subcontractor 
welding-status pages, then the whole NDE-RT / PWHT block, then the four per-subcontractor weld 
rejection pages. The other ~100 PBIX pages (paint progress, welder performance, flange management, 
testpack, and the "Err 1..12" data-quality pages) have no mockup counterpart.

page-level filters (`sections[].filters.byExpr`) and per-visual state

A `byExpr` entry with no `filter` body means the filter card is present but **no value is selected** 
(i.e. the bookmark clears that slicer).
